description: This file defines partitioning functions for Spark SQL connect, including bucket, years, months, days, and hours, with test code for Spark session setup and doctest execution.

methods.name: bucket
methods.description: Defines a bucket partitioning function that takes a number of buckets and a column or name, returning a Column object.

methods.name: years
methods.description: Returns a Column representing the number of years in the given column.

methods.name: months
methods.description: Returns a Column representing the number of months in the given column.

methods.name: days
methods.description: Returns a Column representing the number of days in the given column.

methods.name: _test
methods.description: Runs doctest-based tests for the partitioning functions with Spark session setup.
